speedNote: Per-role speaking-rate multiplier for single-speaker clips (multilingual v2 voice_settings.speed, 0.7–1.2); chosen on 10 September 2026 so that the fast voices from the audition (Roos, Nick, Robert, Peter, Serge) land near 2.5 words per second, the A2 pace of the slower voices. The dialogue model ignores it.
conversationNote: Conversations are generated per turn with eleven_multilingual_v2 and stitched (0.45 s gaps, per-turn loudness normalisation). The dialogue model (eleven_v3) was the default for a day on 10 September 2026 and produced audible room echo on the female voices; it stays available per item with audioMode: "dialogue".
pipelineNote: Since 10 September 2026 clips are requested as 16-bit PCM at 24 kHz, level-matched by a constant gain to -18 LUFS (no compression), stitched losslessly and encoded once to 44.1 kHz MP3 at 192 kbps. An earlier chain re-encoded MP3 three times and normalised twice.
